fdr_method_note: Step-up procedure with monotone running-min adjustment (matches R's p.adjust(p, method='BH')). Computed via stats.fdr.bh_adjust at pool closure. Discovery rule: q_bh <= bh_alpha.
phase1_scope_note: Phase 1 q-values (WHR / TXT / FSLR / RIO / LITE) are frozen and are NOT recomputed against the Phase 2 pool. Phase 2 is a separate FDR scope per phase2_fdr_policy_v1.md Sections 2 and 6.
denominator_inclusion_note: All five entries have a valid pre-registered canonical test committed before any cache backfill or data inspection, were screened against the cohort-default 60-bar BHAR event-study engine, and contribute their primary claimed-horizon raw_p to the denominator. Candidates that failed G5 (AMAT, CF) still count in the denominator per policy Section 3 — removing a failed canonical test after the fact would be selection bias.
claimed_horizon_pool_note: Only the primary claimed horizon h=1 enters the BH calculation for each candidate. Sibling-benchmark p-values, diagnostic-horizon p-values, and restricted-horizon p-values do not enter this pool; they are reported in per-row writeups as supporting context only.
pool_lock_note: Five-row pool defined and closed in a single operator step on 2026-05-28 under policy pattern P1 (pool-then-screen close-out). All canonical tests were complete before this artifact's commit; no further candidates will be added to phase2_pool_v1. Any subsequent Phase 2 candidate forms a separate pool (e.g. phase2_pool_v2) or triggers BH recomputation under pattern P2 as described in policy Section 6.

candidates.phase2_pool_role_note: Canonical test failed G5 at the raw-p stage (h=1 raw p = 0.0527 > 0.05). q_bh > 0.05 confirms the same conclusion under the BH step-up. The row contributes to the denominator per policy Section 3 and does not pass Phase 2 BH/FDR at q<=0.05.

Canonical test failed G5 at the raw-p stage (h=1 raw p = 0.161 > 0.05). q_bh = raw_p at the largest-rank position under BH step-up. The row contributes to the denominator per policy Section 3 and does not pass Phase 2 BH/FDR at q<=0.05.

summary.summary_language: BA, ALB, and NVDA pass Phase 2 BH/FDR at q<=0.05. AMAT and CF are valid Phase 2 BH denominator members that failed G5 and the BH step-up; they remain in the denominator per policy Section 3.

downstream_promotion_note: This artifact records the closed Phase 2 BH/FDR pool. Tracked promotion of any phase2_pool_v1 row into demo_artifacts/section_c_v2/freeze_candidate_evidence.json is a separate explicit operator step and is not performed here. Phase 1 q-values in freeze_candidate_evidence.json are unchanged.
demo_wiring_note: Not wired to the Section C Demo. Per-row q_bh values are mirrored back into the local post-screen artifacts for self-consistency, with this file as the source of record.
limitations: Five-row pool with mixed mechanism families; no cross-row mechanism-family claim is defensible.

Each row's raw_p comes from a single named event with a single pre-registered direction and falsifier. q_bh adjusts only for multiple-comparison error within this five-row denominator; it does not adjust for any out-of-pool selection.
AMAT and CF count in the denominator because their canonical tests were attempted; their failure does not retroactively make BA/ALB/NVDA q-values 'cleaner' than the five-row computation reports.
